title: A scenario file cannot use the tool_called grader
what: Add tool_called to GRADER_TYPES (cherry-pick the lib/relay_bench.py hunk and the test from 5377e9f5); keep the evals/scenarios/check-runs-sketch scenarios only if a scenario is needed for the test.
why: 28 Oct: lib/relay_bench.py GRADER_TYPES lacks "tool_called", so a scenario.toml that names it is refused at load ('unknown type'); the grader landed with bench-tools but is reachable only from code. Found and fixed on wt/spec-met in commit 5377e9f5 (one word plus tests/test_bench.py::test_check_runs_sketch_grader_wants_code_run_not_a_word_or_the_repos_tests), which will not land: its item is dropped.
failing_case: A scenario.toml with a [[graders]] of type tool_called is refused at load with 'unknown type'.
pass_cases: The same scenario loads and its grader runs on a stored session.
